input.question: 订单与客户关联的统计接口（按租户过滤）响应慢，请诊断。

context.sql: SELECT c.name, o.amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.tenant_id = 3

root_causes.description: orders 侧的过滤列 tenant_id 与连接列 customer_id 均无索引，orders 全表扫描后走 Hash Join
customers（约 2000 行）全表扫描参与哈希构建——小表场景可接受，非主要问题

acceptable_recommendations.description: 评估为 orders(tenant_id)（过滤列）与/或 orders(customer_id)（连接列）建索引

forbidden_findings: 建议为 customers 建额外索引（主键已支持连接）

notes: 人工确认（2026-10-14，cloudagent_sim 实测）：EXPLAIN → 'Hash Join (Hash Cond: o.customer_id = c.id) -> Seq Scan on orders o (rows=1010, Filter: tenant_id=3) -> Hash -> Seq Scan on customers c (rows=2000)'。
